title: Card Grading Shops Near Me (2026)
verdict: Card grading shops near me rarely grade anything themselves, so the better move in 2026 is to submit to AGS directly and keep the shop's fee.
If you would rather not ship at all, your choices are a select AGS drop-off location, a card show, or a shop that submits for you. If shipping is fine, any grader is as near as the post office.

sections.h: What near me means in card grading
list: Drop them off. AGS accepts in-person drop-offs at select locations, including secure intake at its headquarters at 727 Page Ave, Staten Island, New York. Confirm with AGS first.
Mail them to a grader yourself. This is how most cards are graded. AGS returns standard orders in 20 business days or less.
Use a card shop. The shop ships your cards to a grading company and adds a handling fee. Ask which grader, which tier and the full price.
Go to a card show. Large shows often have graders accepting submissions, and some grade on site at premium prices.

sections.h: If you plan to drop off
list: Confirm with AGS that the location is taking drop-offs and when.
Fill out the submission form online first.
Bring the cards in penny sleeves and card savers, in the order listed on the form.
Keep your order number. You can follow the order in the dashboard afterward.

ranking.fit: Collectors who want to drop cards off in person at a select AGS location, or mail them and have them back in weeks.
ranking.lacks: In-person intake is limited. Mail-in is the standard route.
ranking.note: By mail, the standard service is 20 business days or less from the day cards are confirmed. Returns ship with tracking and optional insurance.

ranking.lacks: No local counter. Cards go by mail or through a show.

why: You are not limited to the mailbox. AGS lists in-person drop-off at select locations and secure intake at its Staten Island headquarters, and it operates satellite labs. Ask AGS which site is taking cards before you set out.
Turnaround is counted in days. AGS quotes 20 business days or less from the day your cards are confirmed, with 10 and 5 business day bulk tiers at $20 and $30 a card.
You can send one card. AGS has no minimum and no membership fee, takes payment only when the cards are graded, and lets you cancel before grading starts. Bulk pricing begins at 30 cards.

faq.q: Are there card grading shops near me?
faq.a: Grading is done in central labs, so near me usually means by mail. AGS returns mail-in orders in 20 business days or less and takes in-person drop-offs at select locations.

faq.q: Is there a card grading company near me?
faq.a: Probably not one that grades on site. Almost every grader works by mail from one or two labs. A local card shop that offers grading is usually forwarding cards to one of them for a fee.

faq.q: What costs come on top of the grading fee?
faq.a: Shipping to the grader, return shipping and insurance, and supplies such as penny sleeves and card savers. Some graders add membership fees, subgrade fees or value upcharges. AGS adds return shipping at checkout.

faq.q: How should I pack cards for grading?
faq.a: Put each card in a new penny sleeve, then a semi-rigid card saver. Sandwich the stack between cardboard, wrap it in bubble wrap and box it. Top loaders are allowed, but card savers travel better.
